name: Quadratic Form Nullification
description: Transforms the graph independent set problem into finding a binary vector x of Hamming weight k such that the quadratic form x^T M x evaluates to 0, where M is the adjacency matrix. This requires the model to algebraicize the graph constraint, unpack the definition of the quadratic form to realize it restricts pairwise selections, and map it back to the underlying combinatorial structure.
